areas.name: Women
areas.reason: One product on productive inclusion of women among other groups; indicator not fully adequate, small aggregated resources, other dimensions of the objective not covered; slight impact.

areas.name: Indigenous and quilombola peoples
areas.reason: Theme not central; productive inclusion of traditional communities with a reasonably SMART indicator, but aggregated limited resources and narrow scope; slight impact.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Significant alignment and SMART indicators, but components and resources do not prioritize the theme, outputs are dispersed and resource share is limited; low impact.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Significant alignment; dedicated component with a large resource share on climate-resilient farming and rural roads; targets cover only part of demand, so moderate impact.

areas.name: Family farming
areas.reason: High alignment across all final components, relevant resources, well-structured SMART indicators; beneficiary target relevant but limited against total demand; moderate impact.

areas.name: Science, technology and innovation
areas.reason: Aligned with a dedicated research component, but the technology-adoption indicator does not show science or innovation results, so impact could not be measured.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Only a mention of efficient irrigation in one product; no components, products or indicators clearly aligned, so resources and impact could not be assessed.

not_accepted.name: Science, technology and innovation
not_accepted.reason: Aligned with a dedicated research component, but the technology-adoption indicator does not show science or innovation results, so impact could not be measured.

not_accepted.name: Water security
not_accepted.reason: Only a mention of efficient irrigation in one product; no components, products or indicators clearly aligned, so resources and impact could not be assessed.

bonus.reason: Proponent claimed most resources go to two federal priorities (deforestation, climate emergency); the rule requires all resources, so the proponent's own statement defeats the request.
Proponent did not state the programme promotes regional integration.
